t: Tillamook Country Smoker | Oregon Coast | Jerky
s: April 4, 2019 - Some of the best tasting, sought-after jerky in the entire United States originated right here on the Tillamook Coast. Its lengthy history dates back to the days of the pioneers as they crossed the Oregon Trail to reach the Pacific Ocean. As winter started knuckling down around them, the Native Americans taught them how to dry and cure meat into beef jerky to preserve it for the winter.
